inventory.name: Computed-value decoupling of border-width / outline-width / column-rule-width from their *-style properties (zeroing moves to used value)
border-width resolved value stays the used value (getComputedStyle still 0px while border-style is none/hidden)
outline-width and column-rule-width resolved values (getComputedStyle) now reflect the specified value

errors.rationale: A value-computation change on existing presentational properties has no error surface: no exception path, no parse change (grammar untouched, per the syntax section). The developer-facing hazard is behavioral — code inferring 'style is none' from a 0px readback — which the compatibility section documents with the recommended replacement.

securityPrivacy.rationale: Pure value-computation plumbing on long-shipped presentational properties: no new data exposure, capability, or cross-origin surface is introduced by moving the zeroing from computed to used value (the whole change per the cited propdef lines and the ChromeStatus summary/motivation, which frame it as interop/model cleanup for Gap Decorations).

errors.rationale: A resolved-value rule cannot throw; the failure mode is the silent 0px readback while border-style is none/hidden, which the what-changed table and the examples section state explicitly.

securityPrivacy.rationale: Same rationale as the migration item: a CSSOM resolved-value rule over an existing presentational property exposes no new information beyond what the stylesheet itself declares (per the cited css-backgrounds-3 rule).

errors.rationale: No exception path; the migration hazard (code treating a 0px readback as 'style is none') is documented in the compatibility section with the recommended replacement (read the *-style property).

securityPrivacy.rationale: getComputedStyle already exposed these properties; returning the author's specified width instead of 0px reveals only what the page's own stylesheet declares (per the ChromeStatus summary and the cited propdefs).

notes: Contract written during the 2026-09-27 MDN-shape upgrade, which also corrected a factual error in the previous revision: it claimed getComputedStyle().borderWidth returns the authored value in 147+, but css-backgrounds-3 resolves border-width to its used value (0 while style is none/hidden) — only outline-width and column-rule-width change their resolved values, exactly as the ChromeStatus summary states. Runtime behavior is source-derived, not executed locally.
